title: Construction of a diagnostic model based on random forest and artificial neural network for peri-implantitis.
authors: Yang, Haoran; Chen, Yuxiang; Zhao, Anna; Cheng, Tingting; Zhou, Jianzhong; Li, Ziliang
journal: Hua xi kou qiang yi xue za zhi = Huaxi kouqiang yixue zazhi = West China journal of stomatology
one_liner_zh: 该文基于随机森林和人工神经网络构建种植体周围炎诊断模型，虽涉及转录因子-基因互作网络，但核心是基因表达诊断而非蛋白质-DNA结合机制建模，方法为传统机器学习且无三维互作或物理模拟。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to reveal critical genes regulating peri-implantitis during its development and construct a diagnostic model by using random forest (RF) and artificial neural network (ANN). METHODS: GSE-33774, GSE106090, and GSE57631 datasets were obtained from the GEO database. The GSE33774 and GSE106090 datasets were analyzed for differential expression and functional enrichment. The protein-protein interaction networks (PPI) and RF screened vital genes. A diagnostic model for peri-implantitis was established using ANN and validated on the GSE33774 and GSE57631 datasets. A transcription factor-gene interaction network and a transcription factor-micro-RNA (miRNA) regulatory network were also established. RESULTS: A total of 124 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) involved in the regulation of peri-implantitis were screened. Enrichment analysis showed that DEGs were mainly associated with immune receptor activity and cytokine receptor activity and were mainly involved in processes such as leukocyte and neutrophil migration. The PPI and RF screened six essential genes, namely, CD38, CYBB, FCGR2A, SELL, TLR4, and CXCL8. The receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC) indicated that the ANN model had an excellent diagnostic performance. FOXC1, GATA2, and NF-kappaB1 may be essential transcription factors in peri-implantitis, and hsa-miR-204 may be a key miRNA. CONCLUSIONS: The diagnostic model of peri-implantitis constructed by RF and ANN has high confidence, and CD38, CYBB, FCGR2A, SELL, TLR4, and CXCL8 are potential diagnostic markers. FOXC1, GATA2, and NF-kappaB1 may be essential transcription factors in peri-implantitis, and hsa-miR-204 plays a vital role as a critical miRNA.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在揭示种植体周围炎发生发展过程中的关键调控基因，并利用随机森林（random forest, RF）和人工神经网络（artificial neural network, ANN）构建诊断模型。方法：从GEO数据库获取GSE-33774、GSE106090和GSE57631数据集。对GSE33774和GSE106090数据集进行差异表达和功能富集分析。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络（protein-protein interaction networks, PPI）和RF筛选关键基因。利用ANN建立种植体周围炎诊断模型，并在GSE33774和GSE57631数据集上进行验证。同时构建转录因子-基因相互作用网络和转录因子-微小RNA（miRNA）调控网络。结果：共筛选出124个参与种植体周围炎调控的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。富集分析显示，DEGs主要与免疫受体活性和细胞因子受体活性相关，并主要参与白细胞和中性粒细胞迁移等过程。PPI和RF筛选出6个关键基因，即CD38、CYBB、FCGR2A、SELL、TLR4和CXCL8。受试者工作特征曲线（receiver operating characteristic curve, ROC）表明ANN模型具有优异的诊断性能。FOXC1、GATA2和NF-kappaB1可能是种植体周围炎中的关键转录因子，hsa-miR-204可能是关键miRNA。结论：由RF和ANN构建的种植体周围炎诊断模型具有高置信度，CD38、CYBB、FCGR2A、SELL、TLR4和CXCL8是潜在的诊断标志物。FOXC1、GATA2和NF-kappaB1可能是种植体周围炎中的关键转录因子，hsa-miR-204作为关键miRNA发挥重要作用。
